0022600196.text: The Bulls (1-7, 0-2 at home, on a six-game losing streak) are 14th in the East and 5 games back in the Central, and they host the 76ers, who are 8-1, first in the East and the Atlantic, riding a five-game winning streak, and 4-1 at home and 4-0 on the road, with one more game to play before this one. Chicago is without Nic Claxton (out, hamstring strain), while Jalen Smith (hand) and Zach Collins (illness) are day-to-day with game-time decisions, and Philadelphia is missing Ariel Hukporti (out, Achilles surgery) and Dominick Barlow (out, back fracture). The Bulls trail 0-1 in the 2026-27 season series after a 126-107 loss in Philadelphia on November 2, 2026, and they won the 2025-26 series 2-1.
